claim_scope: Sharp minimum four-existentially-closed order within finite Paley graphs over all prime powers congruent to one modulo four; rank-five adjacency theory of the Rado graph.
integrity: All positive and negative finite cases were computed from standalone embedded programs, with independently direct enumeration for the 89-vertex graph. No independent mathematical audit is represented.
scientific_limitations: Only the least order is established. No upper threshold for all higher prime powers; historical priority remains qualified because the 1993 Paley adjacency paper and thesis chapter could not be inspected in full.
title: The 89-vertex Paley graph is the first Paley model of the five-round random-graph theory
